question: Srinivasa Ramanujan, the mathematical genius, was passed away on April 26, 1920, at about what age?
solution:
The correct answer is __**32**__.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
 
• **Srinivasa Ramanujan**, one of the greatest mathematical geniuses, was born on **22 December 1887** in **Erode, Tamil Nadu, India**. 
• He passed away at the young age of **32 years** on **26 April 1920** due to health complications, primarily tuberculosis and related ailments. 
• Ramanujan made significant contributions to mathematical fields such as **number theory, continued fractions, and infinite series**, which remain influential in modern mathematics. 
• During his short life, he compiled nearly **3,900 mathematical results**, many of which were entirely original
